args.diagnosis: compose-post-service is configured to connect to post-storage-service:9090, but the Kubernetes Service for post-storage-service maps port 9090 to targetPort 9999 (and Endpoints list port 9999). final_report.root_cause: A Kubernetes Service misconfiguration: the post-storage-service Service/Endpoints forward traffic from service port 9090 to targetPod port 9999 while the post-storage container listens on port 9090. Clients (compose-post-service) attempt to connect to post-storage-service:9090 and kube-proxy forwards to pod:9999 where no process listens -> immediate Connection refused. A secondary/contributing factor: post-storage pod experienced MongoDB (post-storage-mongodb:27017) unavailability during its startup, causing repeated index-creation errors and delaying the Thrift server startup, which amplified the window of observed failures but did not cause the persistent connection refusals.
